name: qa_lfostep
title: OS-PERF-LFO-STEP: the step FX 23, 24, 33 and 36 on twelve sampler tracks, one song per FX and the control without them (`--var PROJ=LfoStep23|24|33|36|Off`): opened from File, the AFFECTED tracks set once on Performance, `cpu reset`, Play, 8 reads of `cpu` 2.5 s apart. ASSERTS underrun 0 and guard shed 0; the mean `render last` is reported. The project must be on the card first (`o3pj_tool gen lfostep23|24|33|36|off`)

steps.say: OS-PERF-LFO-STEP (QA-PRF-180..189): the step FX Volume LFO 23, Panning LFO 24, Finetune LFO 33 and Position LFO 36 on twelve sampler tracks (four one-shot, four wavetable, four granular; the FX is on every note step at rate 8). BEFORE the run: build the songs (`o3pj_tool gen lfostep23 <dir>/LfoStep23/project.o3pj`, and `lfostep24`, `lfostep33`, `lfostep36` the same, and the control `lfostepoff` into `<dir>/LfoStepOff/project.o3pj`; each writes its samples/ folder beside it) and copy ONE folder into Projects/ per run: the four with the FX, then the control. Run with `--var PROJ=<folder name>`. Use the release image. By ear: the FX of the song at its rate (the FX 36 acts on the wavetable and granular tracks only); the Perform VOL LFO row over the FX 23 and its release (QA-PRF-185). The exports of the control and of a song are compared on the PC with `cmp` (QA-PRF-187). QA-PRF-188: the mean `render last` of each song against the control (no more than the same Perform rows, 1.2 pp, paired noise).
